SELECT StoreName, attainment_pct, bucket FROM (
  (SELECT s.StoreName AS StoreName,
          sum(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(q.SalesAmountQuota), 0) AS attainment_pct,
          'Top' AS bucket
   FROM retail.FactSales f
   JOIN retail.DimStore s ON s.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
   JOIN (SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS SalesAmountQuota
         FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
         WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
         GROUP BY StoreKey) q ON q.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
   WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
   GROUP BY s.StoreName, q.SalesAmountQuota
   HAVING sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) > 0
   ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC
   LIMIT 5)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT s.StoreName AS StoreName,
          sum(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(q.SalesAmountQuota), 0) AS attainment_pct,
          'Bottom' AS bucket
   FROM retail.FactSales f
   JOIN retail.DimStore s ON s.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
   JOIN (SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS SalesAmountQuota
         FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
         WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
         GROUP BY StoreKey) q ON q.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
   WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
   GROUP BY s.StoreName, q.SalesAmountQuota
   HAVING sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) > 0
   ORDER BY attainment_pct ASC
   LIMIT 5)
)
ORDER BY bucket DESC, attainment_pct DESC
